title: Budget 2027: Industry Body BWA Seeks Tax Relief For Crypto Startups
summary: Industry body Bharat Web3 Association (BWA) has submitted its recommendations to the finance ministry ahead of the upcoming Union Budget…
llm_summary: The Bharat Web3 Association (BWA) has sent a set of recommendations to India’s finance ministry ahead of the 2027 Union Budget, urging the government to grant tax breaks for crypto‑focused startups. The body argues that such relief would spur innovation, attract investment and help the country stay competitive in the fast‑growing Web3 ecosystem. It also calls for clearer regulatory guidance to reduce uncertainty for emerging blockchain firms.
